items.title: Scott Yanow interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 22, 2021
items.q: No. I think I have three classical albums.

ctx.x: It’s constant, you know, I mean four or five hours. Sometimes longer, sometimes less. But if I’m not writing I almost always have jazz on on the stereo. © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
Do you ever put anything on like Mozart to sort of reset your ears for a while?

No. I think I have three classical albums. What I’ll do is I’ll switch styles, yeah. When you go from swing to completely avante garde, or fusion to bebop, then you’re not listening to the same music all the time anyway. And it’s just — classical music I mean if I didn’t get into jazz maybe I would have gotten into that, but you know I spend a lot of time listening to 100 Years of Jazz, I really can’t spend the time listening to 400 years of classical. There’s just no time.
